instanceFunctions.getCollisionAreaStat:
Returns the value of the given stat for this CollisionArea. A list of valid stats can be found in (CollisionAreaStats)[CollisionAreaStats.md].

Parameters:
- The name of the (CollisionAreaStats)[CollisionAreaStats.md] to retrieve the value of.


This location of this part is temporary, but it seems this class generally isn't used directly and acts as a parent class for (RectCollisionArea)[RectCollisionArea.md].
instanceFunctions.getPreviousX: Returns the X position of this CollisionArea in the previous frame.
instanceFunctions.getPreviousY: Returns the Y position of this CollisionArea in the previous frame.
instanceFunctions.getType: Returns the type of this CollisionArea. For CollisionArea, it returns `4`.
instanceFunctions.hitTestPoint:
Returns `true` if the given X and Y position is within this CollisionArea.

Parameters:
- `x`: The X position to test for in global coordinates.
- `y`: The Y position to test for in global coordinates.
- `shapeFlag`: An optional parameter that does... something? It is unknown what this does.
instanceFunctions.hitTestRect:
Returns `true` if the given [Rectangle](Rectangle.md) is within this CollisionArea.

Parameters:
- `rect`: The [Rectangle](Rectangle.md) to check an overlap against.
- `shapeFlag`: An optional parameter that does... something? It is unknown what this does.
